interface.name: treeland_personalization_manager_v2
interface.description:
This interface allows a client to customize display effects.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

request.name: destroy
request.description:
Destroy the treeland_personalization_manager_v2 object.
This does not affect any other objects created through this interface.

request.name: get_window_context
request.description:
Create a window personalization context for the given surface. The context allows the client to customize the window's background blend mode, round corner radius, shadow, border and titlebar.
If the wl_surface is destroyed, the treeland_personalization_window_context_v2 object becomes inert and should be destroyed.

request.name: get_cursor_context
request.description: Create a cursor personalization context for the client. The context allows the client to set the cursor theme, size and double-click interval.

request.name: get_font_context
request.description: Create a font personalization context for the client. The context allows the client to set the system font, monospace font and font size.

request.name: get_appearance_context
request.description: Create an appearance personalization context for the client. The context allows the client to set the round corner radius, icon theme, active color, window opacity, window theme type and titlebar height.

interface.name: treeland_personalization_cursor_context_v2
interface.description:
This interface allows a client to personalize the cursor.
Configuration changes are double-buffered. The client should call apply to apply all pending changes at once.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the cursor personalization context. No further events will be sent from the compositor.

request.name: set_theme
request.description: Set the cursor theme name. The change is pending until apply is called.

request.name: set_size
request.description: Set the cursor size in pixels. The change is pending until apply is called.

request.name: set_double_click_interval
request.description: Set the double-click interval, in milliseconds. The change is pending until apply is called.

request.name: apply
request.description:
Apply all pending cursor configuration changes carried by this object.
The compositor will reply with a done event on success, or a failed event if one or more changes could not be applied.

event.name: theme
event.description: Notification of a new cursor theme. This event is sent after the cursor theme has been changed, either by this client or by another client.

event.name: size
event.description: Notification of a new cursor size. This event is sent after the cursor size has been changed, either by this client or by another client.

event.name: double_click_interval
event.description: Notification of the current double-click interval, in milliseconds.

event.name: failed
event.description:
This event indicates that the compositor failed to apply one or more pending cursor configuration changes carried by this object.
This event does not destroy the object. The client may continue using the object and send further requests.

event.name: done

description.summary: end of a cursor state batch

event.description:
This event is sent once when all cursor configuration state events in the current batch have been sent.
The compositor must always end a batch of cursor configuration state events with this event, regardless of whether it sends the initial state or a later update.

interface.name: treeland_personalization_window_context_v2
interface.description:
This interface allows a client to personalize the window associated with the given wl_surface.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

enum.name: blend_mode
enum.description: Window blend mode defines how the compositor composites the window's surface over other surfaces.

entry.name: transparent
entry.summary: composite over background with alpha channel

entry.name: blur
entry.summary: blur the content behind the window

enum.name: enable_mode
enum.description: Describes whether the system titlebar should be enabled or disabled.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the window personalization context. The compositor will revert to its default window styling.

request.name: set_blend_mode

description.summary: set the window background blend mode

request.description: Set the window background blend mode. This determines how the compositor composites the window's surface over other surfaces.

request.name: set_round_corner_radius

description.summary: set the window round corner radius

request.description: Set the window round corner radius in pixels. Invoking this request indicates that the client wants to manage the window round corner radius by itself. If this request is not invoked, the round corner radius will be decided by the compositor.

request.name: set_shadow
request.description: Set the window shadow properties including radius, offset and color. Invoking this request indicates that the client wants to manage the window shadow by itself. If this request is not invoked, the shadow will be decided by the compositor.

request.name: set_border
request.description: Set the window border width and color.

request.name: set_titlebar
request.description: Set whether the system titlebar should be enabled or disabled for this window.
